stories.title: Show HN: Every satellite that passed over any place this week, and its photos
summary: hey HN, i built this because i wanted to know what had actually photographed my street.type in any place and it finds every satellite that passed over it in the last 7 days (SGP4 on the CelesTrak catalog, runs in your browser in about half a second), then pulls the real Sentinel-2 / Landsat / NASA images from those passes.some fun bits: - the pass search can't skip a pass.

checked it against a brute force on poles, the antimeridian and tiny swaths: 0 missed - all ~17k objects in orbit are drawn on the GPU, solving Kepler's equation every frame - Sentinel-2 timestamps are often 5-10 min off from when the sat actually crosses your spot, which was a fun one to figure outit only says "watched" if a real image exists, and it doesn't store your location.code: https://github.com/dev-Armaan/satelliteswould love feedback, especially on what data sources to add Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50428907 Points: 209 # Comments: 43

stories.title: Nvidia’s board needs to do some succession planning – sharpish | Nils Pratley
summary: The chipmaker faces business risks and political scrutiny due to its over-reliance on founder and CEO Jensen HuangWhy is Nvidia’s Jensen Huang at the centre of a US-China row?Too big – and too well-connected – to sack?

One doesn’t have to be overly cynical to think Jensen Huang, the Nvidia boss, starts with one huge advantage as the chipmaker’s board starts its independent investigation into the alleged honeytrap spy scandal.

The world of US big tech is not, to put it mildly, strong on checks and balances on a founder’s power.Huang does not enjoy the supercharged voting rights that are par for the course elsewhere – his shareholding is a plain vanilla 3.6%.
